rawEnrichments.perceptualFlawDescription: The 'Order Details Modal' exhibits inconsistent corner radii, with rounded corners at the bottom and sharp corners at the top.
rawEnrichments.codegenPromptSuggestion: Apply a consistent border-radius to all four corners of the 'Order Details Modal' or ensure the top corners are rounded if it is intended to be a bottom sheet style modal.
